extraction.method: Parse 17 finite name/values or name/items literals from the script linked by official public HTML; quote five object-key aliases then use ConvertFrom-Json; never execute site JavaScript
extraction.note: No browser was available on 2026-10-10; current public static-source retrieval corroborates previous UI rows. Unequal row lengths are preserved, not repaired.
extraction.cleaning: Trim label/value whitespace only; preserve comma decimals, ranges and source terminology; retain raw rows
